title: Keriotosse!
overview:
A kicking game for lively fun again today. A game you can get seriously into and enjoy with friends and family - we've been waiting for it all along!!

- Easy controls let you pull off special moves with satisfying ease.
- The rules are simple: just kick your opponents off the stage.
- Battles for up to 4 players. Everyone can join in the fun.
- Fun stages packed with gimmicks unfold one after another.
- Distinctive 3D characters, with sound effects voiced by an all-star cast of voice actors.

今日もワイワイ元気に蹴るゲー仲間や家族と本気になって楽しめるゲームをぼくらはずっと待っていた!!

★簡単な操作で必殺技だって気持ちよく決まっちゃう。
★ルールは簡単、相手をステージの外に蹴り出すだけ。
★4人までの対戦プレーが可能。みんなで楽しめるね。
★仕掛けがいっぱいの楽しいステージが次々と展開。
★個性豊かな3Dキャラクター、豪華声優陣がSEを担当。
